description:
HR Compliance Analyst

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.
  
  
Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.
  
Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  
  
Why Syneos Health
  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

**Job Responsibilities**

HR Compliance Analyst

Job Summary

The Compliance Analyst is responsible for supporting the execution, administration, and continuous improvement of HR compliance programs across the global organization. Reporting to the Manager, HR Compliance, this role helps ensure adherence to employment laws, regulatory requirements, internal controls, company policies, and data privacy standards while supporting operational excellence within the People Operations function.

The Compliance Specialist serves as a trusted compliance partner to HR stakeholders and plays a key role in regulatory reporting, audit readiness, compliance investigations, risk mitigation, and governance activities. This position works closely with Legal, Internal Audit, HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, HR Technology, Employee Relations, and senior business leaders to address compliance requirements, support audits, resolve complex issues, and mitigate organizational risk.

The ideal candidate possesses strong analytical and problem-solving skills, excellent attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

Core Responsibilities

HR Compliance Operations

* Administer and support HR compliance programs and activities across the employee lifecycle.

* Ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, local, and international employment regulations, company policies, and internal controls.

* Maintain compliance records, documentation, tracking tools, and reporting schedules.

* Support regulatory reporting requirements and government submissions.

* Assist in conducting compliance assessments, monitoring controls, and identifying areas of risk.

* Ensure compliance-related activities are completed accurately and within established timelines.

* Support I-9 employment eligibility verification and reverification tracking for newhires and terminations.

Support occupational health and credentialing administration, including drug screens, physicals, titers, and Letters of Compliance for client and program-specific populations (e.g., IRG nursing, commercial client credentialing).  



Compliance Case Management & Issue Resolution

* Research and respond to compliance-related inquiries from employees, managers, HR teams, and business stakeholders.

* Investigate compliance concerns and recommend appropriate resolutions in accordance with company policies and legal requirements.

* Escalate complex or high-risk issues to the Manager, HR Compliance and appropriate stakeholders.

* Maintain accurate documentation of compliance matters, investigations, and resolutions.

* Support corrective action plans and remediation efforts resulting from compliance reviews or audits.

Monitor trends and recurring issues to identify opportunities for improvement and risk reduction.  



Legal & Executive Stakeholder Partnership

* Partner regularly with Legal, Internal Audit, Employee Relations, HR Business Partners, and senior business leaders to support compliance activities and mitigate risk.

* Serve as a key liaison between People Operations and Legal on compliance-related matters, policy interpretation, regulatory inquiries, investigations, and audit requests.

* Prepare compliance analyses, reports, risk assessments, and supporting documentation for leadership review.

* Support investigations involving regulatory, employment, or policy-related concerns.

* Present compliance findings, recommendations, and status updates to managers and leadership stakeholders as required.

* Collaborate with leadership teams to ensure compliance risks are appropriately identified, documented, and resolved.

Build effective working relationships with stakeholders across multiple functions and organizational levels.  



Regulatory Compliance & Audit Support

* Coordinate and support internal audits, external audits, and compliance reviews.

* Prepare audit documentation, reports, evidence, and responses to information requests.

* Monitor regulatory developments and support implementation of changes to compliance processes, procedures, and policies.

* Track audit findings, action plans, and remediation activities to ensure timely completion.

* Maintain audit-ready records and documentation to support regulatory and internal governance requirements.

Support compliance initiatives related to employment law, data privacy, internal controls, and regulatory obligations.  



Background Screening & Compliance Vendor Management

* Support administration of global background screening programs and related compliance activities.

* Partner with Talent Acquisition, Legal, HR Operations, and vendors to ensure background screening processes comply with company policies and local regulations.

* Monitor vendor performance, service levels, and compliance requirements.

* Assist with compliance-related vendor audits, reporting, and governance activities.

* Coordinate documentation, reporting, and issue resolution with compliance vendors and regulatory bodies as needed.

Ensure appropriate record retention and documentation standards are maintained.  



Systems, Reporting & Analytics

* Prepare compliance reports, dashboards, metrics, and operational analyses.

* Analyze compliance trends, audit results, and case data to identify risks and opportunities for improvement.

* Support regulatory reporting and workforce compliance reporting requirements.

* Partner with HR Technology and Reporting teams to ensure data integrity and reporting accuracy within Workday and related systems.

* Assist with system testing, compliance controls, reporting enhancements, and process automation initiatives.

Leverage data and analytics to support risk mitigation and decision-making.  



Continuous Improvement & Governance

* Identify opportunities to improve compliance processes, controls, service delivery, and operating procedures.

* Support the development and maintenance of standard operating procedures, policies, process documentation, and job aids.

* Participate in compliance projects, system implementations, audits, and transformation initiatives.

* Assist with process standardization, automation, and adoption of new technologies, including AI-enabled solutions where appropriate.

Promote best practices and foster a culture of compliance, accountability, and continuous improvement.  



Additional Responsibilities

* Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

* Support enterprise compliance initiatives and governance activities.

Maintain the highest levels of confidentiality, professionalism, integrity, and ethical conduct.  



Qualifications

Education

Required

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Public Administration, Legal Studies, or a related field.

Preferred

Professional certification such as PHR, SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, CHRC, CCEP, or other relevant compliance or HR certifications.  



Experience & Skills

Required

* 1–3 years of experience in HR Operations, HR Compliance, Shared Services, Employee Lifecycle Administration, or a related field.

* Experience supporting compliance programs, audits, regulatory reporting, investigations, or governance activities.

* Knowledge of employment law compliance, HR policies, internal controls, and regulatory requirements.

* Experience partnering with Legal, Internal Audit, Employee Relations, and senior business leaders on compliance-related matters.

* Experience working with HR systems, preferably Workday.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate risk and recommend solutions.

* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.

* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across all levels of the organization.

* Ability to communicate complex compliance requirements to leadership and non-technical audiences.

* Experience preparing executive-level reports, compliance analyses, and audit documentation.

* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

* Demonstrated ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with sound judgment and discretion.

Preferred

* Experience supporting global or multi-country HR compliance programs.

* Experience with background screening compliance and vendor management.

* Knowledge of GDPR, data privacy regulations, SOX controls, workforce reporting, and audit practices.

* Experience supporting government reporting requirements, including EEO-1 and other regulatory submissions.

* Experience participating in HR technology implementations, process improvement initiatives, or compliance transformation projects.

Experience utilizing reporting, analytics, and automation tools to improve compliance operations.  



Key Competencies

* Compliance & Risk Management

* Relationship Management

* Executive Presence

* Analytical Thinking

* Problem Solving

* Communication & Influence

* Attention to Detail

* Business Partnership

* Collaboration

* Sound Judgment

* Accountability

* Confidentiality & Ethics

* Continuous Improvement

**Position Summary**
====================

The Privacy and AI Governance Manager will strengthen the assessment, implementation and continuous improvement of PGC’s privacy and AI governance programs. The individual will also identify and help operationalize privacy and HIPAA obligations arising from customer contracts and Business Associate Agreements (BAAs) throughout the customer contractual lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Privacy Governance**
----------------------

* Manage the data privacy governance framework, with particular focus on the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and other applicable privacy requirements.
* Identify HIPAA and data privacy obligations arising from external customer contracts and Business Associate Agreements (BAAs), ensure appropriate safeguards are implemented through the contractual lifecycle, including handling of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and Protected Health Information (PHI). Coordinate implementation and ongoing compliance with applicable safeguards.
* Conduct privacy risk assessments, gap assessments, Data Protection Impact Assessments, and remediation tracking for business processes and applications.
* Maintain governance for privacy notices, consent and withdrawal, data-principal rights, records of processing activities, purpose limitation, data minimization, retention, disposal, data flows, and cross-functional accountability.
* Develop and deliver role-based privacy awareness, communications, and training for employees, leaders, process owners and other relevant groups.
* Act as the single point of contact for data privacy matters, providing practical advisory support that ensures compliance requirements are met.
  

**AI Governance**
-----------------

* Operationalize AI governance framework covering entity-level and use-case-level risks and controls across the full AI lifecycle.
* Maintain a standardized AI risk taxonomy, risk and control library, assessment methodology, evidence requirements, maturity criteria, and reporting approach.
* Assess AI control design and operating effectiveness; collaborate with respective control owners to elevate governance maturity and follow through to closure.
* Review AI use cases and provide subject matter expertise on privacy exposures and necessary safeguards.
* Support strengthening policies and procedures on AI governance across variety of use cases (generative AI, large and small language models, agentic AI, enterprise AI, native AI, and third-party AI solutions).
* Align the program, as appropriate, with recognized frameworks such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, healthcare AI guidance, and Providence AI principles.

* Monitor regulatory and industry developments and recommend timely updates to policies, controls, training, and governance practices.

=================================

* Bachelor’s degree in law, information technology, cybersecurity. Postgraduate qualification is preferred.
* 8–12 years of experience in privacy, data protection, technology risk, compliance, information governance, AI governance, or related areas, including experience leading cross-functional programs.
* Working knowledge of the DPDP Act, privacy principles, consent and rights management, records of processing, impact assessments, incident management, retention, and third-party risk.
* Strong understanding of AI governance and risk concepts across design, development, testing, deployment, monitoring, change, and retirement.
* Experience developing risk and control matrices, testing controls, evaluating evidence, assessing maturity, and managing remediation.
* Ability to interpret regulatory and framework requirements and convert them into practical business and technology controls.
* Experience engaging senior leaders and collaborating across cross functional teams.
* Experience in healthcare or another highly regulated environment is preferred.

**Preferred Credentials**
=========================

* Privacy certification such as Certified in Healthcare Privacy Compliance (CHPC), Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP), Certified Information Privacy Manager (CIPM), or an equivalent credential.
* Risk, audit, security, or governance certification such as Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC), or an equivalent credential.
* Training or certification relating to responsible AI, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, AI assurance, or model risk management.

This role collaborates with a range of stakeholders across the Talent Solutions team and business units to execute core HR functions such as onboarding, performance management, employee engagement, and workforce logistics. * Strong Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, HR technology platforms such as Workday, reporting tools, and approved AI-enabled resources.

* Demonstrate ownership, accountability, professionalism, and independent execution and management of assigned responsibilities.

* Produce accurate, organized, and high-quality work products with strong attention to detail and data integrity.

* Anticipate needs, proactively address operational challenges, and approach change with a solutions-oriented mindset.

* Build strong working relationships through responsive communication, follow-through, and service excellence.

JOB DESCRIPTIONHR & Administration Manager

**Company:** SimpliForge 3-D Creation Pvt Ltd  
**Department:** Human Resources & Administration  
**Designation:** HR & Administration Manager  
**Reporting To:** Management / Director  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Work Location:** As per company requirements

1. Job Purpose

The HR & Administration Manager will be responsible for managing the complete employee lifecycle, implementing HR policies and procedures, maintaining employee records, overseeing recruitment and onboarding, ensuring workplace discipline, and managing day-to-day administrative operations.

The role requires a proactive, organised, confidential, and accountable professional who can establish structured HR systems, support management decisions, and ensure smooth business operations.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition**

* Manage end-to-end recruitment, from job posting and candidate sourcing to screening, interviews, selection, and offer issuance.
* Coordinate with department heads to understand manpower requirements.
* Maintain a recruitment tracker and candidate database.
* Conduct background and reference verification where authorised.
* Ensure timely joining, documentation, and induction of selected candidates.

**B. Employee Onboarding & Lifecycle Management**

* Prepare and maintain offer letters, appointment letters, employment agreements, NDAs, and other employee documents.
* Conduct employee induction and explain company policies, code of conduct, reporting structure, and responsibilities.
* Maintain employee master data, personal files, attendance records, and employment history.
* Track probation periods, confirmation dates, notice periods, and employee exits.
* Coordinate exit formalities, full-and-final settlement documentation, and clearance procedures.

**C. HR Policies & Employee Relations**

* Implement and periodically review HR policies, SOPs, employee handbooks, and workplace procedures.
* Ensure employees understand attendance, leave, working hours, work-from-home, fieldwork, confidentiality, and disciplinary policies.
* Handle employee grievances, workplace conflicts, and disciplinary matters professionally.
* Maintain written records of warnings, explanations, investigations, and management decisions.
* Coordinate performance reviews, KRAs, KPIs, probation evaluations, and improvement plans.
* Support the management in maintaining a fair, professional, and accountable work culture.

**D. Attendance, Leave & Payroll Coordination**

* Monitor attendance, late arrivals, absenteeism, overtime, approved leave, and work-from-home records.
* Verify attendance and leave data before sharing it with the accounts/payroll team.
* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs, salary revisions, incentives, reimbursements, and deductions as authorised.
* Maintain records of salary approvals and employee benefit eligibility.
* Ensure salary deductions and recovery of documented training costs, where applicable, follow employment terms and applicable law.

**E. HR Compliance & Confidentiality**

* Maintain statutory HR records and coordinate applicable labour-law compliance with management or external professionals.
* Support compliance relating to EPF, ESI, professional tax, applicable wage requirements, and other statutory obligations, wherever applicable.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee information, salary details, company records, and sensitive management communications.
* Ensure proper execution and storage of NDAs, confidentiality agreements, and authorised access records.
* Coordinate POSH awareness and compliance requirements, including the appropriate Internal Committee wherever legally applicable.
* Escalate suspected misconduct, unauthorised access, document manipulation, or policy violations to management with supporting records.

**F. Office Administration & Facilities**

* Manage office infrastructure, housekeeping, supplies, equipment, maintenance, and general workplace arrangements.
* Maintain registers for company assets, laptops, access cards, ID cards, keys, and other issued equipment.
* Track asset allocation, employee acknowledgements, returns, and clearance during separation.
* Coordinate vendor management, quotations, purchase requests, invoices, and administrative expenses.
* Maintain office documentation, courier records, visitor registers, and essential administrative files.
* Coordinate meetings, travel, accommodation, and other approved logistical arrangements.

**G. Asset, IT & Information Security Coordination**

* Coordinate with the IT team for employee account creation, access permissions, and authorised system usage.
* Ensure employee onboarding and exit checklists include the granting, review, and revocation of access rights.
* Maintain records of company-issued devices, software access, official email accounts, and asset handovers.
* Escalate suspected data leakage, unauthorised surveillance, misuse of company credentials, or confidentiality breaches for appropriate investigation.
* Ensure that company devices, records, and confidential information are returned or transferred through a documented handover process.

**H. Management Reporting & Coordination**

* Submit periodic HR and administration reports to management.
* Maintain dashboards for headcount, vacancies, attendance, attrition, employee performance, and administrative expenditure.
* Coordinate with department heads to resolve manpower and operational issues.
* Track management instructions, policy approvals, pending documentation, and action items.
* Recommend improvements to HR systems, employee processes, and administrative efficiency.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Recruitment turnaround time and vacancy closure rate.
* Completion of employee documentation and onboarding formalities.
* Accuracy of attendance, leave, and payroll inputs.
* Timely completion of probation reviews and performance appraisals.
* Compliance with approved HR policies and statutory documentation requirements.
* Accuracy and completeness of employee and asset registers.
* Timely closure of employee exit formalities and asset handovers.
* Timely submission of management reports.
* Reduction in avoidable administrative delays and documentation gaps.
* Timely escalation and documented resolution of employee grievances and compliance issues.

4. Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related field.
* MBA/PGDM in HR or a relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred.
* Working knowledge of recruitment, HR operations, administration, and employment documentation.

5. Experience

* **Preferred experience:** 3–6 years in HR and administration.
* Experience in a technology, engineering, manufacturing, 3D design, or project-based organisation will be an advantage.
* Candidates with experience establishing HR systems, policies, and SOPs in a growing organisation will be preferred.

6. Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong communication, interpersonal, and coordination skills.
* Excellent documentation and record-management abilities.
* Working knowledge of HRMS, attendance systems, payroll coordination, and Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
* Ability to handle confidential information responsibly.
* Strong organisational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Professional handling of employee grievances and disciplinary matters.
* Attention to detail, integrity, accountability, and follow-through.
* Ability to work independently and coordinate effectively with management.

7. Authority & Accountability

The HR & Administration Manager shall:

* Implement management-approved HR policies and procedures.
* Coordinate recruitment and onboarding within approved manpower plans and budgets.
* Maintain official employee and administrative records.
* Recommend corrective and disciplinary actions to management.
* Process payroll inputs and administrative expenses for authorised approval.
* Escalate significant HR, compliance, financial, and information-security risks.

The role does not independently authorise salary revisions, financial commitments, disciplinary penalties, or changes to company policy unless expressly delegated in writing.

8. Expected Outcomes

Within the initial 90 days, the selected candidate is expected to:

* Establish and update the employee master database and personnel files.
* Standardise recruitment, onboarding, attendance, leave

title: Principal ServiceNow Architect – ITSM & Enterprise Workflow
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Principal ServiceNow Architect to lead the architecture, solution design, technical governance, and implementation of scalable ServiceNow solutions. The individual will be responsible for translating business and IT requirements into secure, maintainable, and upgrade-friendly platform capabilities aligned with ITIL best practices and enterprise architecture standards.

The role requires a strong combination of ServiceNow platform expertise, hands-on technical proficiency, ITSM process knowledge, integration architecture, and stakeholder management. The candidate must be capable of independently handling complex technical challenges, evaluating existing implementations, identifying architectural gaps, and driving solutions from design through deployment and operational support.

The architect will work closely with business stakeholders, ITSM process owners, platform administrators, developers, integration teams, infrastructure teams, security teams, and delivery leadership.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

**1. Enterprise and Solution Architecture**

Define the ServiceNow platform architecture, technical standards, design principles, and implementation guidelines.

Translate business requirements and functional specifications into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions.

Lead architecture assessments, solution design reviews, technical feasibility assessments, and architectural decision-making.

Evaluate out-of-the-box capabilities against customization requirements and prioritize configuration over custom development wherever feasible.

Define reusable architectural patterns, application boundaries, data models, and integration approaches.

Maintain architecture documentation, solution design documents, technical specifications, and architecture decision records.

Assess existing implementations to identify technical debt, architectural inconsistencies, performance bottlenecks, and opportunities for simplification.

**2. ITSM and ITIL Process Architecture**

Design and govern ServiceNow ITSM capabilities, including Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Enablement, Request Management, Knowledge Management, and Service Catalog.

Align platform workflows with ITIL 4 principles and enterprise service management policies.

Review and optimize incident categorization, impact, urgency, priority, assignment rules, escalation, and SLA management.

Define appropriate priority calculation and escalation models, ensuring that business impact and urgency drive consistent prioritization.

Establish standards for incident lifecycle management, major incident handling, problem investigation, change risk assessment, approvals, and service restoration.

Ensure that process implementations are consistent, measurable, auditable, and aligned with operational objectives.

Challenge unnecessary customizations or process variations that increase complexity without delivering measurable business value.

**3. Technical Architecture and Advanced Development**

Provide technical leadership for complex ServiceNow implementations, custom applications, workflows, and platform enhancements.

Demonstrate strong hands-on knowledge of JavaScript, GlideRecord, GlideAggregate, GlideSystem, GlideAjax, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, and Flow Designer.

Design and troubleshoot advanced automation, event-driven processing, asynchronous operations, and complex workflow logic.

Define appropriate use of IntegrationHub, Flow Designer, scripting, scheduled jobs, events, and platform-native capabilities.

Review code for quality, security, scalability, performance, maintainability, and compliance with ServiceNow development standards.

Diagnose complex defects, production incidents, transaction failures, slow-running scripts, and unexpected platform behavior.

Establish development standards, code review practices, reusable components, and technical documentation.

**4. Integration and Data Architecture**

Design and govern integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise systems using REST APIs, SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, and other supported integration mechanisms.

Define authentication, authorization, API security, error handling, retry mechanisms, monitoring, and integration resiliency.

Lead integration design across identity management, monitoring tools, ERP, CRM, HR, cloud platforms, and other enterprise applications.

Establish data ownership, data mapping, transformation, reconciliation, and validation standards.

Govern CMDB data integrations, identification and reconciliation rules, and data quality where applicable.

Troubleshoot integration failures, authentication issues, data inconsistencies, API errors, and performance constraints.

**5. Platform Governance, Security, and Performance**

Establish platform governance, development lifecycle standards, application access controls, and technical quality gates.

Ensure appropriate use of roles, ACLs, authentication, authorization, encryption, and sensitive-data controls.

Define instance strategy, application scope, update-set or application deployment practices, and environment promotion controls.

Establish release, upgrade, regression-testing, and rollback strategies in collaboration with platform operations.

Assess customization impact on upgrades and minimize upgrade conflicts.

Monitor platform health, transaction performance, script efficiency, integration reliability, and technical debt.

Ensure compliance with enterprise security policies, audit requirements, and applicable governance standards.

**6. CMDB, Service Mapping, and ITOM**

Define CMDB architecture, configuration item classes, relationships, ownership, and data quality controls.

Establish configuration management standards and alignment between business services, technical services, and supporting infrastructure.

Provide architectural guidance for Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and operational visibility where these capabilities are in scope.

Define integration patterns for infrastructure monitoring and service health data.

Ensure that CMDB and operational data support incident impact analysis, change risk assessment, and service availability objectives.

**7. ServiceNow Product and Platform Strategy**

Evaluate and recommend appropriate ServiceNow capabilities across ITSM, ITOM, IT Asset Management, Strategic Portfolio Management, HR Service Delivery, Customer Service Management, Security Operations, and Integrated Risk Management, according to business needs.

Assess product fit, licensing implications, implementation complexity, dependencies, and business value.

Identify opportunities to consolidate fragmented workflows and reduce overlapping tools or custom-built solutions.

Define platform evolution roadmaps, capability maturity improvements, and modernization priorities.

Stay current with relevant ServiceNow releases, platform capabilities, architecture guidance, and recommended practices.

**8. Delivery Leadership and Stakeholder Management**

Partner with business stakeholders, process owners, product managers, project managers, and delivery teams to establish solution scope and technical priorities.

Lead architecture workshops, technical design discussions, proof-of-concept exercises, and solution demonstrations.

Provide technical direction and mentoring to developers, administrators, technical leads, and implementation partners.

Review estimates, technical dependencies, delivery risks, and implementation plans.

Support testing strategy, defect triage, deployment readiness, go-live, and post-production stabilization.

Communicate architectural decisions, risks, trade-offs, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

12–15+ years of overall IT experience, with substantial hands-on ServiceNow experience.

Typically 8+ years of ServiceNow implementation and development experience, including significant ownership of complex technical solutions.

Demonstrated experience designing and delivering enterprise-grade ServiceNow architectures.

Strong knowledge of ITSM processes and ITIL principles; ITIL 4 certification is preferred.

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator certification; relevant implementation and architect-level certifications are strongly preferred.

Strong JavaScript and ServiceNow scripting expertise, including complex debugging and code reviews.

Proven experience with REST/SOAP integrations, authentication, data transformation, and integration troubleshooting.

Experience with platform security, access controls, performance optimization, release management, and upgrades.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, stakeholder management, and technical leadership skills.

Ability to work independently, make architecture decisions, explain technical trade-offs, and take ownership of complex issues.

**Preferred Qualifications**

ServiceNow Certified Application Developer certification.

Relevant ServiceNow CIS certifications, particularly ITSM and ITOM where applicable.

ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect or Certified Master Architect credentials, where held and relevant to the role.

Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks, service management governance, and technical debt reduction.

Experience leading multi-team implementations, platform modernization, and enterprise integration programs.

**Expected Outcomes**

A clearly defined, documented, and governed ServiceNow architecture.

Improved platform stability, integration reliability, maintainability, and upgrade readiness.

The vision of the Centralized Timekeeping team is to utilize top talent to streamline time and attendance data entry, reduce payroll defects and provide consistently high service levels. The Centralized team manages the ticket queue by executing on the requests on a FIFO basis but will prioritize any payroll impacting ticket if there is a risk of a payroll defect. The efforts of this team support the business by ensuring associate’s time and attendance matters are handled with speed, precision and with customer obsession always in mind.
